name: Manufacturing
pullQuote: Material chooses the method. Getting that order backwards is how things go wrong.
overview: The manufacturing business works in steel and composites — two materials that behave nothing alike and reward almost opposite instincts. Steel is forgiving in ways composites are not, and composites permit shapes and weights steel will never reach. Holding both means the group can start from the requirement rather than from the material it happens to own equipment for.

Output ranges from structural elements to formed and finished parts. What the work has in common is that it is made to somebody else's drawing and has to arrive right, because a manufactured part that is nearly correct is generally of no use at all.

approach.heading: Two materials, one standard
body: The first decision on any job is which material the requirement actually wants — not which is cheaper by weight, but which will behave under the load, the environment and the handling the part will meet. That decision drives everything downstream, and reversing it later is rarely economic.

Consistency is treated as the product. A run of parts that are individually acceptable but vary between themselves creates work for whoever receives them, so process control is generally held tighter than the drawing tolerance.
